Icons ship on a 24px grid, but the export step trims the transparent bounding
box. Treat the `nominal` size as distinct from the `rendered` size: a nominally
24px glyph can paint at 22px unless the artboard is locked to full bleed, and
conflating them ships misaligned icons.
